name: Korean Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowls

components.name: Beef Bulgogi
steps: Place beef in the freezer for 20–30 minutes if necessary so it slices thinly across the grain.
Combine Asian pear, onion purée, garlic, ginger, soy, sugar and sesame oil; marinate sliced beef at least 30 minutes in the fridge.
Heat a wide pan or grill pan until very hot, then fry beef in batches to get browning instead of pooling sauce.
Reduce any excess marinade in the hot pan so it coats the beef. Return beef and carrots briefly to combine.

components.name: Green Beans
steps: Steam or blanch green beans until just tender.
Portion bulgogi, rice and beans into four meals. Store garnishes separately and reheat all hot components thoroughly.
